The '''Separatist Senate Building''' was a prominent structure in Raxus Secundus's [[Unidentified Raxus Secundus city|capital city]], as it was home to the [[Separatist Senate/Legends|Separatist Parliament]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Description==
[[File:Ciscapitalcity.png|thumb|left|200px|200px|The building in the middle of the urban sprawl.]]
The [[Separatist Senate/Legends|Separatist Parliament]] complex was located in the middle of the [[Unidentified Raxus Secundus city|city]], with circular streets encompassing it and a plaza with trees nearly encompassed by the complex. Inside the main building was the senate chambers, with rows of representatives seated on each side of the [[Separatist Congress Leader/Legends|Separatist Congress Leader's]] podium. [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] would appear in either [[Hologram/Legends|hologram]] form or in person to preside over important decisions.
